fieldData.acrm---key-feature-3-content:
Signatures drawn on any screen

Signers draw with a finger or a mouse. The form stamps the date and time, writes the signature into a PDF of the waiver and emails that copy to the signer for their records.

awb---key-feature-1-image.alt: A kayak renter initials the capsize and cold-water clauses and signs on a phone, and booking #2318 clears for paddles once all 3 adult renters have signed.

acrm---key-feature-2-image.alt: A volunteer roster for the Wendover cleanup shows 34 of 40 waivers signed, reminds the unsigned volunteers by email, and posts the 6 names to the cleanup crew's Slack channel.

acrm---key-feature-3-image.alt: A climber waiver asks for date of birth first, adds a guardian section for a 12-year-old climber, and her mother signs on her behalf before the waiver is saved to the climber's record.

acrm---key-feature-4-image.alt: A vendor table for Gristmill Street Lofts lists each contractor's insurance certificate end date, flags two certificates ending within 30 days and emails Thornbury Electric for a new one.

fieldData.acrm---key-feature-1-content:
Life areas rated on one scale

Ask the client to score career, money, health, relationships, and two more areas out of 10. The two lowest ratings move to the top of the prep sheet you read before the first call.

fieldData.awb---key-feature-1-content:
By September 5, Amaya has her trial with Liesel

Amaya Szabolcs is getting married on October 17 and books Liesel Ruskova for the day. She answers with a 3 pm outdoor ceremony, 4 people getting makeup, dry skin, and 3 inspiration photos. The form sets her trial for September 5, 6 weeks before the wedding, and saves the booking with every answer.

acrm---key-feature-2-image.alt: Mara Quinlan's family history lists four relatives with the condition and age at diagnosis; her mother's type 2 diabetes at 52 and her brother's high blood pressure at 38 are listed first in the summary for Dr. Aldana.

thumbnail-image.alt: Build a medical history form that stays current, with Emergent

fieldData.awb---how-to-step-4-des: Pick the people who read health answers, such as the trip leader or the dive instructor. Everyone else gets a link and a note that a record is ready for review. The details stay in the app.

fieldData.acrm---key-feature-1-content:
Movers and hours set by home size

Set how many movers and hours each home size takes, plus your hourly rate. The form multiplies them as the customer answers and shows the estimate before the request is sent.
